evolution.title: feat: add per-channel availability toggle for product variants (#19795)
evolution.detail:
Forward-port of #19795 from 3.23 to main.

Adds `ProductVariantChannelListing.is_available_for_purchase`, letting staff hide a variant in a single channel without deleting its listing and prices. A listing with the flag set to false is treated as if it did not exist for customers (availability, price range, checkout/order lines, promotions).

Port adjustments for main:
- Dropped the preorder threshold lines from the conflicting hunks; main removed the preorder API.
- Kept `ADDED_IN_323`: the feature first ships in 3.23.
- Kept migration 0215_productvariantchannellisting_is_available_for_purchase under its 3.23 name and added 0216 merge migration with main's 0215_merge_20261010_1621.
- No CHA
evolution.prTitle: feat: add per-channel availability toggle for product variants (#19795)
evolution.value: Lets merchants control whether a product variant is available in each sales channel. This PR references #19795; both entries may represent related work rather than separate launches.

evolution.title: fix(structured_output): skip reasoning JSON when selecting output
evolution.detail:
## Summary

Fixes #43983
Fixes https://github.com/langgenius/dify/issues/44080

Structured Output parses the whole accumulated message content, and providers concatenate a
reasoning model's chain of thought into that content inside `` tags. When the reasoning
contains a JSON object of its own, the text is not valid JSON, so the repair fallback runs,
`json_repair` turns it into a list of candidate objects and the first one wins — so the reasoning
object is returned as `structured_output` instead of the answer. The reported case comes back as
`{"think": "start"}` even though the final response is the schema-shaped object.

evolution.title: fix(api): accept MCP protocol version 2025-11-25
evolution.detail:
## Summary

Fixes #44064

The MCP client still offered `2025-06-18` and rejected an initialize result of `2025-11-25`, so saving an HTTP MCP server that speaks that revision failed after HTTP 200. The client now offers `2025-11-25` and still accepts `2024-11-05`, `2025-03-26`, and `2025-06-18` when a server negotiates down. The Dify MCP server's advertised versions stay on `2025-06-18`.

evolution.title: fix(nodejs-client): replace stale user fields in native upload forms
evolution.detail:
## Summary

Fixes #44119.

Native FormData retains old user values when reused for `fileUpload` or `audioToText`: the SDK appends the current user while the service API selects the first `user` field. A prepopulated form or second upload can therefore retain the previous user instead of the explicit method argument.

Replace user fields with `FormData.set` when available, and keep the append path for legacy form-data without set. Preserve file payloads, upload routes and the existing form mutation behavior.

Adds four real-fetch multipart cases covering both public methods with pre-existing user fields and form reuse. The local server verifies decoded user values, file content/name and unrel
evolution.prTitle: fix(nodejs-client): replace stale user fields in native upload forms
evolution.value: Ensures reused upload forms use the current user rather than retaining a previous user field.
